Title: Disappointing experience regarding punctuality and commitment. Strongly recommend a demo class before paying.

"I am writing this review to share my factual experience after enrolling in a 1-on-1 course (3 months) + Group course (1 year) package, costing ₹60,000.

Unfortunately, the service delivered did not match the promises made during admission:

Breach of agreed format: I paid specifically for '1-on-1' sessions. However, after some time, I was asked to merge with a group class, which defeats the purpose of the premium fee I paid.

Punctuality Issues: There were consistent delays. On several occasions, the faculty was late or absent. In one specific instance, I waited 30 minutes past the scheduled time with no communication.

Infrastructure: The classroom environment was uncomfortable due to ineffective air conditioning, and basic study materials/books were not provided even upon request to purchase.

Refund Policy: When I raised these valid concerns regarding service deficiency and requested to discontinue the group portion, I was refused a refund based on company policy, despite the institute failing to uphold their end of the teaching schedule.

Advice to future students: Before committing a large sum like I did, I highly recommend you insist on taking a demo class for at least a week to judge the consistency and infrastructure for yourself. Do not rely solely on the sales pitch."

=========================================

Reply to the owner’s response dated March 6, 2026.

"I appreciate your acknowledgement of these issues. Since the academy has admitted to not fulfilling the agreed 1-on-1 format and terms, I believe the most fair and professional resolution is a refund of the difference for the services not rendered. I look forward to your proposal on how this will be processed."

Now that things are online, it doesn't even make sense paying double, being in Mumbai, you can still learn from AF Pune, or AF Bangalore or any other city, since it's all online.
Take my suggestion, dont invest in AF Mumbai, it's a disappointment.

featured_reviews.name: Sathish Naragoni
featured_reviews.review_text:
This was honestly one of the worst-managed exams I’ve ever attended. The management is terrible, and the maintenance of the place is pathetic. You can clearly hear outside noise inside the exam hall, which makes it impossible to focus. The two small rooms used for exams are right next to each other, and audio easily travels between them  completely unfit for an exam environment.

There’s no proper timer inside the exam room either. The whole setup looks totally unprofessional for an institute like Goethe.

According to the schedule, the exam was supposed to start at 1:00 PM, and the listening section should have started at 1:30 PM and should ended at 2:00 PM. But instead, they made us to start the writing part at 1:52 PM, which is supposed to start only at 2:00 PM. The invigilator started to give the papers at 1:00 PM itself...how pathetic! (most of the other centres like chennai and Bengaluru they will give the exam paper 2 -5 mins earlier before the commencement of exam and they make sure you open the exam paper at right scheduled time)which makes no sense  and they collected our answer sheets at 2:22 PM. Everything felt rushed, unorganized, and unfair.

In Chennai and Bengaluru Goethe centres, everything runs smoothly and on time they follow proper exam structure and timing. I have no idea what’s wrong with Mumbai Goethe, but this centre is not at all suitable for exams.

Final advice: not even worthy of rating of 1 star ,Don’t waste your time or money here. I strongly recommend avoiding the Mumbai Goethe-Institut for exams.

Goethe Institut Mumbai is a pathetic institute.
Teachers are not up to the mark as well, they do not entertain us asking doubts or questions.
Whatever we ask they keep repeating like a tape record that you will learn this in the next course.
Teachers speak German as if they are singing a song, it is nowhere near the hochdeutsch.

After attending 4 month course and spending our hard earned money - students are good for nothing. They cannot even speak or write a simple line in German.

If we ask any doubt: they will ask us “NOT TO TRANSLATE” and teaches us in sign language, this is the most ridiculous thing I have seen. After we encounter difficult words / sentences/ grammar students are left to wonder with their imagination rather than translating it or giving analogy in english or native language.

India is a country where a new language is spoken after every 1 kilometer. Imagine if the people in India themselves followed these foolish teaching techniques to learn other Indian languages- where will we reach??

There is a teacher who shows expressions and actions (for explaining deutsch) and shamelessly asks students- did you understand??

It is a blatant loot and fooling people. Poor college students think this is how we should study german.

There has to be atleast 1 German native speaker for a batch and not these 2nd hand experienced teachers who fill their pockets by fooling people.

Even when we are giving feedback via the app- the teacher stays inside the classroom and they know exactly who gives what. The key reason why students are skeptical to complain.

After studying here in the Mumbai branch for 4 months I started hating the language and when I discovered some other native speaking teachers on youtube and instagram: my faith in german was restored.

Please don’t fall for the equation: Goethe Institut is the legitimate source of German; No it is a mockery of german language that they make.

I hope their president Carola takes note of this and fires these unworthy teachers.

The teachers are good for nothing and this is kind of their backup job after being unsuccessful in whatever they were pursuing in their life and we the poor students fall prey to such underskilled teachers.

One office staff Guy sits outside the classrooms and begs for money if we don’t show our I card for a lecture. And what does that prove? Collecting fine legalizes your enrollment then why pay the fee?

Last but not the least:
The classroom size : this is the biggest joke. Even a public transport bus is having enough room to seat people. The classroom size and shape is like a public toilet where students sit knee to knee. Hardly fitting our books / study materials etc on the table. It is next to impossible to sit and join a study room like the one they maintain.

Goethe Institut like any other product of Germany was and is always a standard of perfection; please maintain it and fire these unworthy teachers from your org who are aimed to fill their pockets and doom the organization.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I completed the A1 German language course at The American Institutes, Andheri West, and overall it was a really good experience. I joined as a complete beginner, and by the end of the course I was able to understand basic German, form simple sentences, and communicate with more confidence.

I’d definitely recommend this institute to anyone looking to start learning German from scratch.
